crossRefs.note: “You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO YAHWEH.’
crossRefs.keyword: fine linen or silk wound round its bottom

crossRefs.note: He set the turban on his head. He set the golden plate, the holy crown, on the front of the turban, as Yahweh commanded…

translations.web: You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.
translations.bsb: Put the turban on his head and attach the holy diadem to the turban.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.
translations.asv: and thou shalt set the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.
